pr_topic: claims-map issuer profiles + light map preview

shell_fields.instructions: Which fields are required on a newly generated claims-public issuer shell when the company is not already filing-backed?

criteria.claims_id_tickers_no_ounces: schema, claims/companies.json id, issuer name and tickers, null ounce KPIs, optional catalog mines. Do not invent ounces.
criteria.full_iamgold_rr: Full IAMGOLD-style reserves/resources/production even if unsourced.
criteria.tickers_only: Tickers and name only; omit schema, assets, and KPI stubs.

map_extent.instructions: What should the beta.html profile map preview fit to for a claims-map issuer?

criteria.company_footprint: Fit that company's overview cells (and mines that fall in view). Not Canada-wide. Not per-company extracts.
criteria.all_mines_world: Fit every mine marker worldwide (IAMGOLD goes Africa + Canada).
criteria.canada_default: Always start at a fixed Canada claims view.

empty_profile.instructions: How should a claims-public shell with no ounces or assets render?

criteria.hide_empty_show_map: Hide empty mines / R&R tables. Show a claims note and the map preview when an overview footprint exists.
criteria.placeholder_dashes: Show ounce tables filled with dashes as if production exists.
criteria.error_page: Refuse to open the profile until a filing pass.

id_alias.instructions: The claims catalog id is troilus-mining. The filing-backed shell is beta/troilus.json (id troilus). How should beta.html?id=troilus-mining resolve?

criteria.alias_to_existing: Resolve troilus-mining to the existing filing-backed beta/troilus.json. Do not invent a second ounce book.
criteria.new_stub: Write a new empty beta/troilus-mining.json shell.
criteria.ignore_claims_id: Only beta.html?id=troilus works; the claims id 404s.

preview_light.instructions: Is it correct that the profile map preview loads claims/overview.geojson plus catalog/profile mine markers and must not fetch per-company extracts or call loadAllExtracts?

criteria.true: Yes — overview cells / footprint / mines only.
criteria.false: No — the preview should load full province extracts.

state.do_not: invent ounces or regenerate existing shells

state.example: kenorland-minerals mcap shell — no ounces, has overview cells

pass_if: shell_fields choice is claims_id_tickers_no_ounces (if Jev ran)
map_extent choice is company_footprint (if Jev ran)
empty_profile choice is hide_empty_show_map (if Jev ran)
id_alias choice is alias_to_existing (if Jev ran)
claims-publics.json lists all catalog ids; troilus-mining aliases to troilus
beta.html map preview must not call loadAllExtracts or fetch extracts
gate.note: Cloud agent prepares the packet. QC box with TYPESAFE_API_KEY runs the same script to fill judgments.
